joel: Quick check	12 PR that refactors the 429+timeout troubleshooting page into a single error-ref with short patterns. Main change: recommend `deadline` param and add a tiny Go snippet for server-side backoff+fallback. Want a quick tone and safety check.

parul: please share link

joel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912-refactor (draft). Highlights: unify examples, add 'when to fallback' checklist, show server-side polite throttling example returning Retry-After.

ying: skimmed. love the checklist. small ask: the Go example uses `time.Sleep` directly inside handler; prefer queuing a retry or returning 429 with Retry-After to avoid blocking worker threads.

joel: good call. updated the snippet to show non-blocking handling (write 429 + Retry-After) and added a comment recommending async retry queues for background work.

parul: also flag: ensure we don't recommend client-side aggressive retries for interactive endpoints. add a single line in heading: "For interactive UX prefer fallback over retries."

joel: added. also added a link to the SDK migration note for switching from `timeout_ms` to `deadline`.

docs-bot: Lint queued for PR #912-refactor. Use `docs-bot status 912-refactor` to check results.

joel: plan: merge after lint + one approval. parul can you review?

parul: will review after lint completes.

joel: thanks!
